name: ada
title_zh: 开工前先读这页的私人工作协议
tagline_zh: 每次任务开头都自动加载：写作口径、完成定义、禁区清单、当前项目。不用你重复交代，它先把自己调成你的默认值。
tagline_en: Auto-loads at task start: writing style, done-definition, no-go zones, current projects. No need to re-explain.
desc_en: Who Ada is and how to help them well: how they want things written, what counts as done, what must never happen without asking, and what they are working on. Use at the start of any task for Ada.
why_zh: 不是通用助手，是把你自己的偏好固化成可执行协议。它知道哪些事必须问、哪些算完。
why_en: Not a generic assistant—it codifies your preferences into an executable protocol. Knows what must be asked, what counts as done.
limit_zh: 只服务 Ada 本人，换人用需重写全部偏好；不主动产出内容，只做上下文加载；超出已记录项目范围时，它不会猜。
limit_en: Only serves Ada; others must rewrite all prefs. Produces no content alone—just context. Stops and asks if a task falls outside recorded project scope.
title_en: A pre-task briefing that loads Ada's working agreement first
